display.purpose: The one 22px number on the page: the idle countdown, colored by verdict.

headline.purpose: The page title in the header.

aux.purpose: Tables, the status word, gates, header subtitle.

motion.name: tray-chevron
motion.purpose: The page's only motion: the logs-tray chevron rotates when the dock expands. The 5s redraw must stay motion-free.

components.name: State Word
components.description: The color-coded live state (Idle / Busy / Running Idle Tasks / Degraded) — the page's hero; sits left of the Engine gate.
components.html: IdleBusyRunning Idle TasksDegraded
components.css: .ds-state-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-state { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-state--ok { color: var(--ok); } .ds-state--warn { color: var(--warn); } .ds-state--accent { color: var(--accent); } .ds-state--err { color: var(--err); }

components.name: Engine Gate (global)
components.description: The header kill-switch combobox; two fixed options (Engine Paused / Engine Running); disabled at 0.55 opacity when no client is registered.
components.css: .ds-gate { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-gate:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-gate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Gate (per-client)
components.description: The small per-client gate in the Clients table rows.
components.html: <select class="ds-gate ds-gate--small" aria-label="client gate"><option>Engine Paused</option><option>Engine Running</option></select>
components.css: .ds-gate { padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); cursor: pointer; } .ds-gate--small { font-size: 11px; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-gate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Section Panel

components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 14px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text); } .ds-panel-head { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: var(--dim); font-weight: 600; } .ds-kv { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; } .ds-kv-k { color: var(--dim); } .ds-kv-v--ok { color: var(--ok); } .ds-empty { color: var(--dim); font-style: italic; padding: 6px 0; }

components.name: Idle Countdown
components.description: The single 22px display number: idle-for value, colored ok/warn by the live verdict.
components.css: .ds-kv { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 2px 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 13px; color: var(--text); } .ds-kv-k { color: var(--dim); } .ds-big { font-size: 22px; } .ds-big--ok { color: var(--ok); }

components.name: State Tag
components.description: Exception-only chips: the border takes the semantic color with the text; no tag is the healthy state.
components.html: active active finished paused budget full paused
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: transparent; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--mono); } .ds-tag--ok { color: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); } .ds-tag--accent { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-tag--warn { color: var(--warn); border-color: var(--warn); } .ds-tag--err { color: var(--err); border-color: var(--err); }

components.name: Budget Bar
components.description: Daily token budget: 6px hairline track, blue fill; turns amber (hot) past 80% of the cap.
components.css: .ds-budget-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-budget { height: 6px; width: 180px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 3px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-budget-fill { height: 100%; width: 42%; background: var(--accent); } .ds-budget-fill--hot { background: var(--warn); width: 91%; }

components.name: Worker Row
components.description: One allocated worker: online dot (green/dim), bold name, dim meta (model, ~estimate), right-aligned queued count.

components.css: .ds-worker { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 1px 0; font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text); } .ds-worker-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--dim); } .ds-worker-dot.on { background: var(--ok); } .ds-worker-name { min-width: 84px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-worker-meta { color: var(--dim); } .ds-worker-queue { margin-left: auto; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: The lease/event tables: 12px, dim 600 header with a hairline, rows divided at 50% hairline, no zebra.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--text); } .ds-table th { text-align: left; color: var(--dim); font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-table td { padding: 3px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(48, 54, 61, 0.5); } .ds-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; } .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text); } .ds-tag--accent { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-tag--warn { color: var(--warn); border-color: var(--warn); }

components.name: Logs Tray
components.description: The fixed bottom dock: uppercase toggle with chevron, Events/Leases tabs, records-to-show select, count pushed right.
components.html: events 10 · leases 3
components.css: .ds-tray { background: var(--panel); border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: var(--mono); } .ds-tray-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 5px 16px; } .ds-tray-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: none; padding: 2px 4px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tray-toggle .ds-tray-chev { display: inline-block; transition: transform 0.15s ease; font-size: 13px; } .ds-tray-toggle:hover { color: var(--accent); } .ds-tray-tabs { display: flex; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tray-tabs button { background: var(--bg); border: none; color: var(--dim); font: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 10px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tray-tabs button.active { color: var(--text); background: var(--panel); } .ds-tray-select { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; font: inherit; font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 4px; } .ds-tray-count { margin-left: auto; color: var(--dim); font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Gate Token Input
components.description: The arbiter API token field under the Clients panel; stored to localStorage, never rendered back.

components.css: .ds-input-token { background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; padding: 2px 6px; width: 240px; } .ds-input-token::placeholder { color: var(--dim); } .ds-input-token:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
The idlefill dashboard is an instrument panel, not a website. It sits on a dark canvas in one monospace family at a density an operator can read across the room in a single glance: a color-coded state word, a kill-switch combobox, four data panels, and a log dock pinned to the bottom edge. The page polls every 5 seconds and redraws itself; nothing animates, nothing floats, nothing asks for attention. The only saturated pixels on the page are live state.

Color is scarce by doctrine. A single neutral ramp — the GitHub dark (Primer) palette, used unmodified — carries all structure: panels, hairlines, labels, empty states. Four signal colors (green, amber, red, blue) appear only where a live verdict needs them: the Idle/Busy/Running Idle Tasks/Degraded word, online dots, the budget bar, and exception tags. If a pixel is colored, something is happening.

Depth is tonal, not lifted: the canvas sits darker than the slate panels, and 1px hairlines do the work shadows would. Radii are small and utilitarian (3–10px), borders always 1px. The result is a control room that stays quiet while the machine sleeps — and speaks plainly the moment it wakes.
keyCharacteristics: One monospace family, 11–13px base, a single 22px display number
Four signal colors, state-only: green quiet, amber blocked, red failed, blue working
Zero shadows; tonal layering plus 1px hairlines
Fluid auto-fit panel grid (min 340px columns), no media queries
Exception-only tags: no tag is the healthy state
Fixed bottom logs tray (a dock) with a single 150ms chevron transition

rules.name: The One Word Rule
rules.body: The state is the word, not the frame. Live state rides the color-coded status word; control frames around it — comboboxes, borders, default badges — stay neutral.

rules.name: The Exception-Only Rule
rules.body: Tags appear for exceptions only (paused, budget full, forced). No tag is the healthy state; a running or scheduling tag is noise.

rules.name: The One Typeface Rule
rules.body: There is one family on the page. Hierarchy comes from size, weight, and tracking — not from a display face.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and flat always; state is communicated with color and text, never lift.

dos: Do let one color-coded word carry the live state (Idle / Busy / Running Idle Tasks / Degraded) and keep every frame around it neutral.
Do divide with 1px hairlines: Hairline at panel edges, the 50% hairline inside tables and project blocks.
Do reflow panels with the auto-fit grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(340px, 1fr)), 14px gap) instead of adding breakpoints.
Do set every panel head at 11px / 600 / +1px tracking, uppercase, Muted Gray.
Do reserve the 22px display size for the idle countdown alone.
Do keep schedule lines in plain words: runs when idle ≥Ns · max N jobs at a time · auto-cancels after Xm.
donts: Don't add shadows or gradient washes — depth is tonal layering plus 1px hairlines only (the page has zero box-shadow).
Don't render a tag for the healthy state: no tag means running, fine (no running, no scheduling).
Don't animate anything but the tray chevron (150ms ease); the page redraws every 5s, so motion is a defect.
